items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: So Marshall Stearns launched your literary career, with the review.

He sure did. Not long after he said, “I think I’ll just keep reviewing records,” which I was sorry to hear him say, because I wanted to get free records. But he said, “Why don’t you do all the other stuff?” Get the New York news to him once a month and write the “Collector’s Corner” column. He said, “At this point in time, you know enough to be able to do it.” He was right. I’d done other things that helped my background in that, but I’ll cover that in a moment. So, having inherited those two things from…
So you really had educated listening too.
